test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 10th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Numerically, what percentage of its circumference is the area of a circle of radius 4?
solution:
Given:

Radius = 4

Concept used:

Area of a circle = πr²

Circumference of the circle = 2πr

Where r = radius of the circle

Calculation:

Circumference of the circle = 2π × 4 = 8π

Area of the circle = π × 4² = 16π

Now, % = 16π/8π × 100%

⇒ 200%

**∴ Numerically, 200% of its circumference is the area of a circle of radius 4.**
